# Notifications

## GET `/api/v1/notifications`
List own unexpired notifications, newest first
- operationId: `listNotifications`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`, `query:unreadOnly (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → NotificationListResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `422` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/notifications/unread-count`
Count own unexpired unread notifications
- operationId: `countUnreadNotifications`
- Params: —
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → NotificationUnreadCountResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse

## PATCH `/api/v1/notifications/read-all`
Mark visible own unread notifications read atomically
- operationId: `markAllNotificationsRead`
- Params: —
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → NotificationReadAllResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## PATCH `/api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`
Idempotently mark one owned notification read
- operationId: `markNotificationRead`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → NotificationReadResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `422` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse
